title: Comparison of Three Species of Rhubarb in Inhibiting Vascular Endothelial Injury via Regulation of PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Li, Xin; Huang, Songli; Zhuo, Bingyu; Hu, Jingyan; Shi, Yue; Zhao, Jiangyi; Tang, Jincheng; Hu, Xiuhua; Wei, Shengli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大黄三种物种通过PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路抑制血管内皮损伤，涉及分子对接但核心为中药药理与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIM: Rhubarb, a traditional Chinese medicine derived from three species, is commonly used in the prescriptions for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis based on its traditional effects of removing blood stasis and dredging the meridians. It has been reported that rhubarb can protect blood vessels by reducing inflammation and inhibiting vascular endothelial injury (VEI), but the effective components and mechanism of rhubarb inhibiting VEI are still unclear. This study aimed to compare the differences in chemical compositions of the three species of rhubarb and their inhibitory effect on VEI, so as to explain the material basis and select the dominant species to inhibit VEI, and to elucidate the mechanism of rhubarb's inhibitory effect on VEI. METHODS: Plant metabolomics was used to compare the chemical components of three species of rhubarb. The efficacy of three species of rhubarb in inhibiting VEI was compared through cell experiments in vitro. At the same time, combined with network pharmacology and molecular docking, the effective components and pathways of rhubarb involved in inhibiting VEI were screened. The mechanism of rhubarb inhibiting VEI was verified by molecular biology. RESULTS: There were significant differences in the distribution of chemical components among the three species of rhubarb. We identified 36 different chemical components in the positive ion mode and 38 different chemical components in the negative ion mode. Subsequently, the results showed significant differences in inhibiting VEI among the three species of rhubarb based on the contents of inflammatory factors (such as IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha), ROS, and NO and confirmed that R. tanguticum had the best inhibitory effect on VEI in the light of the comprehensive efficacy, compared with R. palmatum and R. officinale. Three species of rhubarb alleviated the inflammatory response in LPS-induced EA.hy926 cells by reducing the contents of inflammatory cytokines IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha and decreasing expressions of PI3K, AKT, NF-kappaB p65, and STAT3 protein in the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway and the inhibition of proteins phosphorylation. In addition, three species of rhubarb could lessen the contents of ROS and NO in EA.hy926 cells induced by LPS. All results indicated that the process of inflammation-induced cellular oxidative stress, which resulted in VEI, was obviously improved by three species of rhubarb. CONCLUSION: R. tanguticum was more effective among three species of rhubarb, and it had been proved that gallic acid, gallic-acid-O-galloyl-glucoside, procyanidin B-2,3,3'-di-O-gallatein, and other potential components could reduce the contents of inflammatory factors (such as IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha), ROS, and NO by inhibiting the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and protected the vascular endothelium and the blood vessels by improving the inflammation and oxidative stress reaction.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：大黄是一种源自三个物种的传统中药，基于其祛瘀通经的传统功效，常用于活血化瘀的方剂中。据报道，大黄可通过减轻炎症和抑制血管内皮损伤（VEI）来保护血管，但大黄抑制VEI的有效成分及机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在比较三个物种大黄的化学成分差异及其对VEI的抑制作用，以阐明其物质基础并筛选抑制VEI的优势物种，同时揭示大黄抑制VEI的机制。方法：采用植物代谢组学比较三个物种大黄的化学成分。通过体外细胞实验比较三个物种大黄抑制VEI的功效。同时，结合网络药理学和分子对接，筛选大黄参与抑制VEI的有效成分及通路。通过分子生物学验证大黄抑制VEI的机制。结果：三个物种大黄的化学成分分布存在显著差异。我们在正离子模式下鉴定出36种不同化学成分，在负离子模式下鉴定出38种不同化学成分。随后，基于炎症因子（如IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha）、ROS和NO的含量，结果显示三个物种大黄在抑制VEI方面存在显著差异，并确认在综合功效方面，唐古特大黄（R. tanguticum）对VEI的抑制作用最佳，优于掌叶大黄（R. palmatum）和药用大黄（R. officinale）。三个物种大黄通过降低炎症细胞因子IL-6、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha的含量，以及减少PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路中PI3K、AKT、NF-kappaB p65和STAT3蛋白的表达并抑制蛋白磷酸化，从而缓解LPS诱导的EA.hy926细胞中的炎症反应。此外，三个物种大黄还能减少LPS诱导的EA.hy926细胞中ROS和NO的含量。所有结果表明，炎症诱导的细胞氧化应激过程（导致VEI）在三个物种大黄的作用下得到明显改善。结论：在三个物种大黄中，唐古特大黄（R. tanguticum）效果更佳，并已证明没食子酸、没食子酸-O-没食子酰葡萄糖苷、原花青素B-2,3,3'-二-O-没食子酸酯等潜在成分可通过抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路降低炎症因子（如IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha）、ROS和NO的含量，并通过改善炎症和氧化应激反应保护血管内皮及血管。
